title: Over his collar
html_source: Implicature returns the reader to a suspenseful experience of Bloom. Why would he think of ‘Brown brilliantined hair’ when he’s out at the bog! (Norris, M. Virgin and Veteran readings of Ulysses, p94).

anchor.prefix: remember that. Hallstand too full. Four umbrellas, her raincloak. Picking up the letters. Drago's shopbell ringing. Queer I was just thinking that moment. Brown brillantined hair
anchor.suffix:
. Just had a wash and brushup. Wonder have I time for a bath this 1939#52morning. Tara street. Chap in the paybox there got away James Stephens, they say. O'Brien.
